# Index

The index lists every term marked in a book page and every H1 and H2 heading. Mark a term with an HTML comment `<!-- index: term, other term -->` anywhere outside a code fence. A quoted term may contain a comma. The same term may point at more than one page. Within a letter, terms are ordered by their spelling, ignoring case. Each term's links are ordered by page path, then by heading anchor. A heading anchor is included when that heading's slug is unique on the page.

The single-file manual's sidebar is a table of contents: each entry jumps to that chapter. To save a PDF, open `docs/manual/manual.html` in a browser and choose Print, then Save as PDF. The page has a print style that shows every chapter. No PDF tool is listed in the workspace dependency document, so the manual does not write a PDF file.
